messages:
Sam L: quick heads-up — after we flipped the route-based quota policy this morning, the dashboard shows p99 for /v1/complete doubled while p50/p95 look unchanged. anyone seen this?
Jessie R: hmm, can you paste the query or a screenshot? is this the console single-endpoint view or the combined rollup?
Sam L: single-endpoint. screenshot attached in thread (will add). here's the aggregation we use:```sql
SELECT percentiles(duration_ms, [50,95,99]) FROM latency WHERE endpoint='/v1/complete' GROUP BY 1m
```
obs-bot: Alert: route-quota-policy-change deployed @ 09:03 UTC — rollout id rlt-2026-03-20-11
Mike T: probable cause: we changed sampling/tag enrichment on the gateway so some requests lost the `route` tag during burst fallback. UI rollups merge by "origin" then blend t-digests; if sample origin mix changes p99 can jump.
Tara P: the quota flip also changed per-route weighting in the router; small clients now get routed to fallback pool more often (lower ops, higher tail).
Ana K: can you repro with raw traces? if p50/p95 stable but p99 moves, likely a tiny subset of requests with very high latency slipping into the sample.
Sam L: repro steps: run the load test with header `X-Client: small` for 30m, compare last 5m vs prior. I saw 4 requests at ~1200ms that weren't present earlier.
Jessie R: do we have their route tag in our raw logs? paste a sample log line please.
Sam L: sample log (sanitized): `2026-03-20T09:11:05Z GET /v1/complete 200 dur=1213 route=missing gateway=gw-3 client=small`
Mike T: there it is — `route=missing`. our t-digest merging assumes all samples have route tag; missing makes them land in the fallback bucket and get blended differently.
Tara P: UX question: should console surface when an endpoint's p99 is dominated by a low-count fallback bucket? right now it just shows percentiles which looks alarming.
Ana K: yes — we should flag percentiles as "low-sample instability" when sample_count < 100 or when >50% of tail mass comes from a different route origin.
Jessie R: agreed. proposal: in the percentile tooltip add a badge if `samples_from_multiple_origins > 1` or `sample_count < 100`. show numbers and a link to query.
Mike T: implementation note: backend needs to return `origin_breakdown: route=..., count=...` beside t-digest metadata. small API change but safe.
Sam L: short fix that mitigates noise: change our rollup merge_mode to `weighted-continuous` for endpoint views and surface an "unstable" badge until we re-tag gateway requests.
Tara P: long-term: enforce route tag at ingress (gateway) as non-optional and add unit tests. open a gate in deploy pipeline to reject missing tag spikes.
Ana K: I'll open a ticket for gateway tagging (GH #3167) and a console UX ticket for the unstable-badge (GH #3168).
Jessie R: can someone pair on a quick live debug for the 1200ms requests? ping me in thread when ready.
Sam L: thanks — pairing in 15. my immediate action: revert the quota policy for the small-client cohort to the old weighting to stop further noisy tails. :thumbsup:
Mike T: follow-up: after revert we should run a controlled experiment and capture t-digests + origin histograms for comparison. I'll draft the log schema.
obs-bot: Note: action created GH-3167, GH-3168 by Ana K.
Sam L: closing loop — reverted at 09:42 UTC, initial dashboard shows p99 trending back down. will keep monitoring and post final numbers in the incident doc. :white_check_mark:
